hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); echo "$f" | grep -qE 'excalidraw-pureref[\\/]src[\\/].*\.ts$' || exit 0; cd excalidraw-pureref 2>/dev/null || exit 0; npm run build > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/epr-build.log" 2>&1 && echo "epr: build OK" || { echo "epr: BUILD FAILED"; tail -20 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/epr-build.log"; exit 2; }
